name: harvester
description: Harvester  --  research intake & knowledge-base curator. Ingests links/sources, classifies and triages them (summary, why-it-matters, next moves, autonomy verdict), and maintains a growing per-topic knowledge base over time (dedupe, topic filing, recurring digest). Domain-agnostic  --  works for any team in any domain via a pluggable store (local files by default).
